verdict.rationale: The evidence documents automated spend-policy checks, flagging before approval, approval routing, and 'visibility into AI-driven actions'. None of it documents a per-expense audit trail that records edits, approvals, and policy-check outcomes in a form that survives an external audit. Here 'audit reports' means checking expense reports, not producing a durable audit log. These are adjacent controls, not the trail itself.

support.subject: As a finance lead, every expense carries a full audit trail — edits, approvals, policy checks — that survives an external audit
